Remark
[The end compactification] ↗ def:space-of-ends The space of ends of a connected manifold is a compact space, and one can define a topology on the union of $M$ and its space of ends making this union a compact, connected Hausdorff space which is a compactification of $M$. We will not use these facts in this chapter.
